title: Disclaimer
estimates: The numbers are estimates for practice. This app is not a certified launch monitor.
carry: Carry comes from a model: spin is not measured (a typical value for the club is used) and wind is ignored.
ranges: The ± after a number is a 95% confidence interval: the true value is inside that range about 95% of the time. A number that cannot be measured shows — with the reason; it is never guessed.
views: Numbers measured from different camera angles are not directly comparable; comparisons say so.
safety.title: Safety
safety.tripod: Put the tripod outside the swing path, ideally behind the bay partition. Make a practice swing first to check you cannot hit it.
safety.people: Make sure nobody is near you before you swing, and don't look at the phone while swinging.
